processed_text: A 4-year-old male child is brought by his mother with complaints of poor weight gain, frequent loose motions, and low appetite over the last two months. Immunization status is incomplete as per the mother, and the child often falls sick with cough and fever. Drinking water source is a hand pump, and sanitation facilities are limited. The child appears tired and less active compared to other children of the same age.
